text: Bitcoin's modest 1.1% gain alongside Ethereum's slower 0.8% move suggests cautious consolidation rather than conviction, with smaller caps (BNB, SOL) outpacing the majors—a sign traders are rotating risk. The Fear & Greed index at 27 reflects persistent pessimism that has barely budged upward over a week, indicating shallow confidence in any bounce. Bitcoin's elevated 56.2% dominance combined with modest $36B daily volume suggests the market is in a holding pattern, with capital concentrated in BTC but without the volume momentum needed to establish a meaningful trend.
